entities.name: Jon
entities.description: One of the two speakers. A banker who lost his job on 19 January 2023 and spent the rest of 2023 trying to found his own dance studio, hunting for premises, writing a business plan and looking for investors. He has danced since childhood and calls it his escape and stress-buster; contemporary is his favourite style; his dance crew won a local competition in 2022. He visited Paris on 28 January 2023 and Rome in June 2023, and is a close friend of Gina, who encourages him in every session.

entities.name: Gina
entities.description: One of the two speakers. She lost her job at Door Dash in January 2023 and started her own clothing business, designing a store space and opening an online clothing store she announced on 16 March 2023. She dances for stress relief, competed as a teenager and won a regional competition at fifteen with a contemporary piece called "Finding Freedom", and has a tattoo standing for freedom. She interviewed for a design internship on 10 May 2023 and was accepted for a part-time fashion internship reported on 27 May 2023. She is Jon's close friend and his constant encourager.

entities.name: Shia LaBeouf
entities.description: The actor whose "Just do it" motivational speech Gina quoted to Jon on 23 July 2023 to spur him on. The only person named in the conversation apart from the two speakers.

entities.name: Jon's dance studio

properties.aliases: the dance studio; my studio; the studio; my biz

entities.description: The dance studio Jon set out to found after losing his banking job in January 2023, and the conversation's main subject. He pictured a space by the water with an ocean view, looked at a downtown place with good natural light and wanted Marley flooring; he was still searching for premises through at least May 2023, worked on a business plan, investors, social media and networking, and set an official opening night for 20 June 2023. By 21 July 2023 he described it as on tenuous ground and had taken a temporary job to cover expenses. From February 2023 onwards he also spoke of it as already running, with students, classes and workshops, which the rest of the conversation does not bear out.

entities.name: Gina's clothing store

properties.aliases: my store; my clothing store; my online clothing store; my online store; the online clothes store

entities.description: The clothing business Gina started after losing her job at Door Dash. It is referred to as "my clothing store", "my store" and "my online clothing store" and treated throughout as one business, although the conversation describes both a physical space she designed in a shopping mall in early 2023 and an online store she announced as open on 16 March 2023; those mentions are joined here as one subject. She ran an advertising campaign in January 2023, secured a wholesaler on 1 February 2023, partnered with a local artist on designs, ran offers and promotions, made a limited edition line in June 2023, was noticed by fashion editors in July 2023 and built an ordering website shortly before 21 July 2023.

entities.name: Door Dash
entities.description: The company Gina worked for until she lost her job there in January 2023. That loss is what pushed her into becoming an entrepreneur and starting her own clothing business.

entities.name: the international company where Gina interns

properties.aliases: an international company; the fashion department

entities.description: The unnamed international company whose fashion department accepted Gina for a part-time internship, which she reported on 27 May 2023. She had interviewed for a design internship on 10 May 2023 and said it went great; the two mentions are joined here as one position.

entities.name: Jon's dance crew

properties.aliases: my dance crew; the small group of dancers I rehearsed with

entities.description: The small group of dancers Jon rehearsed with after work, covering everything from contemporary to hip-hop. They took first place at a local competition in 2022, and in January 2023 were finishing choreography for a nearby festival the following month, which Jon performed at and described as awesome on 8 February 2023.

entities.name: dance
entities.description: The shared passion at the centre of the conversation and the thing that connects the two speakers. Jon has danced since childhood and calls it his escape, his stress-buster and where he feels most alive; Gina calls it her stress relief and says she cannot picture life without it, that it is like air. Both competed when younger, both name contemporary as their favourite style, and Jon's entire business plan is built on teaching it.

entities.name: contemporary dance
entities.description: The dance style both speakers name as their favourite — Jon because it is expressive and powerful, Gina because it is expressive and graceful. "Finding Freedom", the piece Gina's team won a regional competition with, was a contemporary work.

entities.name: Paris
entities.description: The city Jon visited on 28 January 2023 and described as very cool. Gina said she had never had the chance to visit it.

entities.name: Rome
entities.description: The only city abroad Gina says she has visited, once, as of January 2023. Jon took a short trip there in the week before 19 June 2023 to clear his mind while working on his business.

entities.name: The Lean Startup
entities.description: The business book Jon was reading in May 2023, hoping it would give him tips for his dance studio. It got him thinking about building a focused and efficient business and about adapting from customer feedback, which he said he would try.

entities.name: Finding Freedom

properties.aliases: a contemporary piece called Finding Freedom

entities.description: The contemporary dance piece Gina's team performed when they won first place at a regional competition when she was fifteen. She describes it as really emotional and powerful, and that win is her favourite dance memory.

entities.name: Gina's freedom tattoo
entities.description: A tattoo Gina got a few years before February 2023. It stands for freedom — dancing without worrying what people think — and she keeps it as a reminder to follow her passions and express herself.

entities.name: Jon's planning whiteboard
entities.description: The whiteboard Jon keeps of ideas, dates and milestones for his dance studio business. He uses it to visualise his progress and stay organised, and colour-codes achievements on it so he can track them and stay motivated.

claims.speaker: Jon

claims.text: Gina built a new website for customers to place orders in the week before 21 July 2023 and said it had been a wild ride she was loving.
claims.speaker: Gina

claims.text: On 21 July 2023 Jon said the dance studio was on tenuous ground and that he had taken a temporary job to help cover expenses while he looked for investors.
claims.speaker: Jon

claims.text: Jon said on 21 July 2023 that running a business is not easy but that he was determined to make it work.
claims.speaker: Jon

claims.text: Gina's biggest business hurdle was sourcing trendy pieces for her store, which took a lot of research and networking; her advice to Jon was not to be scared to reach out to people in his field for help and contacts.
claims.speaker: Gina

claims.text: Jon had been networking through mid-2023 and said on 21 July 2023 that it had got him some good results, sharing a picture from his most recent networking event.
claims.speaker: Jon

claims.text: At his most recent networking event Jon met some investors and got good advice, and said the energy there gave him a boost to go after his goals.
claims.speaker: Jon

claims.text: Acting on the advice from that networking event, Jon was sprucing up his business plan, tweaking his pitch to investors and working on an online platform to show off the dance studio.
claims.speaker: Jon

claims.text: Jon asked Gina on 21 July 2023 for help with marketing strategies to reach his target audience and raise awareness for the dance studio.
claims.speaker: Jon

claims.text: Gina advised Jon to use Instagram and TikTok to reach a younger crowd, post dance clips and dance-related content, and collaborate with local influencers or dance communities, and offered to make content or manage his accounts.
claims.speaker: Gina

claims.text: Jon and Gina agreed on 21 July 2023 that Gina would help create content and manage the dance studio's social media accounts.
claims.speaker: Jon

claims.text: Jon and Gina said on 21 July 2023 that they were excited to collaborate and to make an impact together by teaching others through dance to chase their dreams.
claims.speaker: Jon

claims.text: On 23 July 2023 Jon said he had been rehearsing hard and working on business plans, that it had been stressful, and that dancing had kept him going.
claims.speaker: Jon

claims.text: Gina spurred Jon on during their 23 July 2023 conversation with the "Just do it" motivational speech, which she identified as Shia LaBeouf's and repeated at the end of the conversation.
claims.speaker: Gina

claims.text: Gina went to a dance class with a group of friends on Friday 21 July 2023.
claims.speaker: Gina

claims.text: Gina said on 23 July 2023 that having a creative space for dancers is important and that Jon's studio would become a go-to spot for self-expression.
claims.speaker: Gina

claims.text: Jon said on 23 July 2023 that he could not wait until his studio starts welcoming dancers of all ages and backgrounds.
claims.speaker: Jon

claims.text: Gina told Jon on 23 July 2023 that every step was getting him closer to his dream, and Jon said he would keep going whatever came his way.
claims.speaker: Gina

claims.text: Jon's dance studio went from a plan he formed after losing his banking job on 19 January 2023, through months of searching for premises and then a business plan and investor hunt, to an official opening night set for 20 June 2023 — and by 21 July 2023 to tenuous ground with a temporary job covering his expenses.
claims.speaker: Jon

claims.text: Gina's clothing business went from an advertising campaign and a store space she designed in early 2023, through the online store she announced as open on 16 March 2023 and a limited edition line in June 2023, to being noticed by fashion editors and building an ordering website in July 2023.
claims.speaker: Gina

claims.text: Jon and Gina both lost their jobs in January 2023 and each answered it by starting their own business — Jon a dance studio, Gina a clothing store — and they encouraged each other through it in every conversation across 2023.
claims.speaker: Gina
